key_difference: (B) only adds a RunFunctionTaskBase destructor that cancels and finishes an unfinished promise, while (D) adds a new exported QtCore interface (QRunnableDiscardHandler) that QThreadPool::clear() finds with dynamic_cast, changes the base classes of inline QtConcurrent templates, and also reworks the ThreadEngine map/filter path through threadExit(), which brings in ABI/ODR, RTTI and engine-lifetime risks that (B) deliberately avoided.
